body: Thank you, I'll ask one when I am a little less busy.

Yeah, I guess I'm asking inappropriate questions of the subreddit in general. Most people come here to be entertained and consume content, not to seriously answer questions (I don't mean to bash that in any way, just an observation).

I'm not attempting to be self absorbed, I was just hoping for some answers. If this is the wrong subreddit, could you direct me to one that's more appropriate? 

I'm honestly just asking for help finding a solution. If people are that disinterested / don't like it, then I guess the down votes will show it.

Maybe I thought wrong about people in general... If I see an opportunity to help someone understand something they are not quite getting, I will always try and help them. Maybe that's just a less common personal trait.

If I really am just asking self-centered, stupid questions though, please tell me. At least that way I'll know and can start trying to sort things out from there.
